sanskrit: manmathe ca hṛdi hantum udyate proṣitapramadayedam udyate nirdayena paradeśasevinā māriṣyatha hi tena māṃ vinā anyadeśaratir adya mucyatāṃ sāthavā tava vadhūḥ kim ucyatām cātakaś ca tṛṣito 'mbu yācate duḥkhitā pathika sā priyā ca te ambudaiḥ śikhigaṇo vinādyate kā ratiḥ priya mayā vinādya te toyadāgamakṛśā ca sādya te durdhareṇa madanena sādyate śokasāgarajale ca pātitāṃ tvadguṇasmaraṇam eva pāti tām dravati ca kaluṣaṃ jalaṃ nadīnāṃ kim iti ca māṃ samavekṣase na dīnām gambhīramegharasitavyathitā kadāhaṃ jahyāṃ sakhi priyaviyogajaśokadāhaṃ

sanskrit: madanasya kṛte niketanānāṃ pratibhānty adya vanāni ketanānām tvaṃ mañjarībhiḥ pravaro vanānāṃ netrotsavaś cāsi sayauvanānām kuṭaja kiṃ kusumair avahasyate praṇipatāmi ca duṣprahasya te tava puṣpanirīkṣitāpadehaṃ visṛjeyaṃ sahasaiva nīpa deham madhunaḥ samavekṣya kālatāṃ bhramaraś cumbati yūthikālatām salilair vihataṃ rajaḥ kṣitau ravicandrāv api nopalakṣitau navāmbumattāḥ śikhino nadanti meghāgame kundasamānadanti sendrayudhaś ca jalado 'dya rasann ibhānāṃ saṃrambham āvahati bhūdharasannibhānām paridhīraravaṃ jalaṃ darīṣu prapaty adbhutarūpasundarīṣu

## ghat-p02 (1)
for-Kāma / for-sake / of-abodes / shine / today / groves / of-abodes / you / by-sprouts / chief / of-groves / eye-festival / and / you-are / of-youths / kuṭaja / why / by-flowers / are-you-laughed-at / I-bow / and / hard-to-laugh-at / to-you / your / flower-looked-at / body / I-would-release / quickly / indeed / nīpa / body / of-honey / having-observed / season / bee / kisses / yūthikā / creeper / by-waters / scattered / dust / on-earth / sun / moon / and / not / are-seen / new / by-cloud / peacocks / cry / at-cloud-arrival / kunda / same-toothed / with-Indra's-weapon / and / cloud / today / resounds / of-elephants / ardor / brings / mountain-like / loud / roar / water / in-caves / falls / wonderful / formed / beautiful // ghat-p02
l2:
For Kāma's sake, today the groves of abodes shine.

You are chief of groves by sprouts, eye-festival of youths.

Kuṭaja, why are you laughed at by flowers? I bow — hard to laugh at you.

Your flower-looked-at body — I would release it quickly, nīpa, body.

Having observed honey's season, the bee kisses the yūthikā creeper.

By waters scattered, dust on earth; sun and moon are not seen.

New-cloud-drunk, peacocks cry at cloud-arrival.

With Indra's weapon, the cloud today resounds, bringing the elephants' ardor, mountain-like.

Loud roar — water in caves falls, wonderful-formed beauties.

sanskrit: utkaṇṭhayanti pathikāṇ jaladāḥ svanantaḥ śoko vivardhati ca tadvinatāsv anantaḥ ratyutsavaṃ priyatamaiḥ saha mānayanti meghāgamaṃ priyasakhi śvasamānayanti jīyeya yena kavinā yamakaiḥ pareṇa tasmai vaheyam udakaṃ ghaṭakarpareṇa

## ghat-p03 (1)
make-long / travelers / clouds / thundering / sorrow / grows / and / in-those / endless / love-festival / with-beloveds / they-honor / cloud-arrival / dear-friend / they-bring / may-I-be-conquered / by-which / poet / by-yamakas / other / to-him / I-pour / water / in-potsherd // ghat-p03
l2:
Clouds thundering make travelers long; sorrow grows in those, endless.

They honor the love-festival with beloveds; cloud-arrival, dear friend, they bring.

May I be conquered by which poet, by yamakas, other; to him I pour water in ghaṭakarpara.
